mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals increased consumer demand and corporate earnings power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.5 million units signals weakening residential investment and broader demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 1.5m (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1% growth signals supply-side weakness that reduces corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO growth is below 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating and impending wage inflation, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 2% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand for corporate goods and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating and impending wage inflation, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS 3-month change > 150000 AND UNRATE falls below 4.0% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k and UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
